title: Quentin and the Autopsy
author: Hazel Nystrom
blurb: Quentin Nakamura, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
